meta.question: on CUB, does rollout over late student blocks only keep the masked teacher's TCKD/KL better than full rollout at the same K, on final and mid-training students, without a centre bias?
meta.method: keep-only masked-teacher faithfulness (KL to full teacher, DKD TCKD/NCKD split, p_true, top-1 agreement) for rollout start-block sweep, plus centre-distance / centre-overlap of kept tokens
